source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per turn, for your whole army, during [your opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), as an enemy unit picks a **KROOT INFANTRY** unit of yours up to 6" from this unit as an attack's target, this unit can use this ability. If it does, once that enemy unit has resolved its attacks, this unit can shoot as though it is [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). Those attacks can target only that enemy unit, provided that enemy unit is an [eligible target](vsdata:core-rule/select-targets).

trigger.event: friendly KROOT INFANTRY unit targeted by an attack
